body.name: Candy Cane
body.description: The magic of the season is wrapped within every peppermint twist of these candy canes. They're not just a treat for the taste buds but a treasure trove of winter delight and unexpected value.

body.name: Candy Corn
body.description: Savor the spirit of spookiness with these tri-colored candy corn treats, a sugary staple that adds a dash of fun to every ghostly gathering.

body.name: Captain's Corroded Key
body.description: A key long submerged beneath the sea, its surface heavily rusted. It may have once belonged to one of the many shipwrecked captains.

body.name: Captured Energy Flakes
body.description: A small shard of energy left behind as a Demon Imp dissipated. It holds an unstable essence of darkness.

body.name: Captured Mana Flakes
body.description: Luminescent flakes radiating a soft glow and carrying traces of otherworldly magic.

body.name: Castillon Dagger

body.name: Cave Trolls Precious Rock
body.description: A smooth, round stone with no notable features beyond its shape and surface. It appears to be a treasured item to a cave troll.

body.name: Centaur Hoof
body.description: This ebony black Centaur hoof, once traversing the fiery depths of forbidden realms, still carries traces of blood in its remaining fur tufts, serving as a dark souvenir from a hellish world.
